title: Boils fast
text: Replaced a ten-year-old kettle. This one hits a rolling boil in about ninety seconds for two mugs, and the lid catch is stiff enough that it doesn't flap open when you pour. Limescale filter pops out for rinsing. Only gripe: the water window is on the left, awkward if you're right-handed.

title: AMAZING PRODUCT MUST BUY
text: This premium quality kettle offers exceptional performance and outstanding value for money. The sleek modern design fits any kitchen. Highly recommend this fantastic product to all customers. Five stars!

title: Great kettle
text: I received this product at a discount in exchange for my honest review. It works well and heats quickly, no complaints so far after a week of use.

title: Never arrived
text: Three weeks and the courier still hasn't delivered it. Tracking says it's at a depot forty miles away. Cannot comment on the kettle itself because I have never seen it.

title: Best value in 2026 #AsterHome
text: Switched to Aster and never looking back! #AsterHome The whole range is worth it, use code ASTER20 at checkout for money off. Check out their toaster too, it's on my channel.

title: Flickers on the lowest setting
text: Fine at full brightness but on the two lowest dimmer steps it has a visible flicker that gives me a headache after an hour. Support suggested it was my dimmer switch, but it's plugged straight into the wall. Returning it.

title: My sister loves it
text: Bought this for my sister and she says it's brilliant, really bright and the arm holds its position. She uses it for sewing. I haven't used it myself but going on what she told me it's a five.

title: Solid, arm droops a bit
text: Six weeks in. The light quality is genuinely good for detail work, warm enough at 3000K that it doesn't feel clinical. The lower arm joint has started to droop under its own weight if I extend it fully, which I didn't expect this soon.

title: Superb
text: Excellent product. Very good quality. Fast delivery. Would buy again. Recommended.

title: Box was crushed
text: The parcel arrived with a corner stoved in and the driver left it in the rain on the doorstep. Lamp seems okay actually, I've not properly tested it, but one star for the delivery experience.
